entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean Hotman, Marquis de Villiers-St-Paul was a French diplomat. Although he came from a Calvinist family, who had been exiled during the French Wars of Religion, Jean, through cultivating connections with Henry IV eventually was restored to a portion of his patrimony.
